RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is weak evidence on its own. Panel composition reflects who holds senior HR and risk roles in that organisation, and panels of a single sex occur frequently by chance alone. Raising it as your opening argument signals grievance rather than substance, and it is easy to dismiss.

Your stronger ground is concrete: your doctorate and nine years of direct modelling experience against a master's and vaguely described "regulatory affairs" experience, plus a two-week silence on a reasonable request for written reasons. Chase that request in writing, citing the deadline in the recruitment policy. If the reasons are evasive or the stated criteria shifted after shortlisting, you then have something real — with or without the panel point.
